title: patient.guardian.handover_completed.v1
description: The age-18 handover ended (IDC-012): the young adult claimed the profile with an OTP (online or at the desk), or 30 days passed with no claim and guardian access ended. Subject = the patient. Opaque reference and codes only. keptScope is the proxy scope the adult kept for the former guardian (NONE when access ended). Consumers core.identity: log-only handler until it exists.

patientRef.description: The young adult's opaque patient reference.

version.description: Outbox id of this event: monotonic per aggregate.
